title: A Newton Identity and Finite-Rank Reconstruction for the Queer Lie Superalgebra
summary: We establish a Newton-type identity for the queer Lie superalgebra $\mathfrak q_N$, relating Sergeev's odd cyclic central elements to Nazarov's one-row Capelli elements. The identity is obtained by comparing Ivanov's generating function for factorial Schur $Q$-functions with the queer Perelomov-Popov product of Grigoryev and Nazarov. Its coefficient expansion yields a triangular change of generators between the odd cyclic and odd one-row families.
